class ImageBuildClient(ABC):
    """
    Abstract base class for container image build clients. Provides the interface that both SDK-based and
    CLI-based implementations must satisfy.
    """

    @abstractmethod
    def build_image(
        self,
        path: str,
        dockerfile: str,
        tag: str,
        buildargs: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
        platform: Optional[str] = None,
        target: Optional[str] = None,

        """

        Parameters

        path : str
            Path to the build context

            Path to the Dockerfile

        buildargs : Optional[Dict[str, str]]
            Optional build arguments

            Optional platform to build for
        target : Optional[str]
            Optional build target stage
        rm : bool
            Remove intermediate containers, defaults to True

        Returns
        -------
        Generator[Dict[str, Any], None, None]
            A generator of build log entries
        """

    @staticmethod
    @abstractmethod
    def is_available(engine_type: str) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[str]]:
        """
        Check whether this build client is available for the given engine type.

        Parameters
        ----------
        engine_type : str
            The container engine type (e.g. "docker" or "finch")

        Returns
        -------
        Tuple[bool, Optional[str]]
            A tuple of (available, error_message). error_message is None when available.
        """


class SDKBuildClient(ImageBuildClient):
    """
    ImageBuildClient implementation that uses the docker-py SDK to build container images.
    """

    def __init__(self, container_client: Any) -> None:
        """
        Parameters
        ----------
        container_client : ContainerClient
            The container client used to build images
        """
        self._container_client = container_client

    def build_image(
        self,
        path: str,
        dockerfile: str,
        tag: str,
        buildargs: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
        platform: Optional[str] = None,
        target: Optional[str] = None,
        rm: bool = True,

            "tag": tag,

            build_kwargs["buildargs"] = buildargs
        if platform is not None:
            build_kwargs["platform"] = platform
        if target is not None:
            build_kwargs["target"] = target
